subject: Aligning next steps and stakeholders for a focused technical deep dive
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Helen Cho <helen.cho@finlytics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cope@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning next steps and stakeholders for a focused technical deep dive

Hi Helen — thanks again for the time today, appreciate the clear outline of priorities. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive that brings the right people from both sides: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary goal: validate latency and SSO integration for your ingestion pipeline, confirm data residency constraints.
- Success metrics: sub-200ms p95 inference on 4k tokens for batch scenarios; clear SSO + SCIM onboarding path.
- Constraints: procurement prefers a short vendor evaluation window (30 days).

Proposed technical deep dive (30–45m) — we suggest one of these slots: 
1) Wed 6 Oct — 10:00–10:45 PT
2) Thu 7 Oct — 14:00–14:45 PT
3) Fri 8 Oct — 09:00–09:45 PT

Please let us know your preference and who from security/procurement you'd like on the call. I’m looping in Soojin (CSM) and Marissa (SE) so they can help scope the agenda and own evidence requests. I’ve attached my notes from today for reference.

Attachments: discovery_notes.docx (summary)

Next steps: if one of those times works we’ll circulate a tight agenda (authentication, infra, short demo, Q&A) and a link to a short pre-demo checklist for SSO and firewall rules.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

On Thu, Sep 30, 2026 at 12:05 PM Helen Cho <helen.cho@finlytics.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the call, Sean — the team appreciated the quick walkthrough.
> 
> — Helen
From: Helen Cho <helen.cho@finlytics.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning next steps and stakeholders for a focused technical deep dive

Hi Sean — thanks for the summary and the proposed slots.

Quick responses:
- Procurement (cc’d) will need to be in the loop — I’ve added Raj.
- Security (cc’d Maria) will need the SOC2 / network boundary info before the deep dive.

For timing, Thu 7 Oct looks promising. Two notes: procurement prefers slightly earlier or later than 14:00 PT (they have an internal review 13:30–14:15). Can you do 13:00–13:45 or 14:30–15:15? If not, 14:00 is still possible and we’ll try to cover the procurement items asynchronously.

Also, please include a short agenda (25m technical + 15m procurement/security); Maria, Raj — we’ll need any pre-reads you ask for. I’ve attached our initial security questionnaire to help prioritize evidence.

Thanks,
Helen Cho
Head of Data Platform | Finlytics
helen.cho@finlytics.com | +1 617-555-0123

Attachment: finlytics_sec_q_01.xlsx

On Thu, Sep 30, 2026 at 3:12 PM Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cope@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning next steps and stakeholders for a focused technical deep dive

Hi all — thanks for the quick replies and for looping procurement + security in. I’m Soojin; I’ll coordinate logistics and make sure the agenda maps to the right owners. 

We can absolutely do Thu 7 Oct — thanks for flagging Raj’s constraint. To keep things simple: can we tentatively lock Thu 7 Oct 14:00 PT and shift procurement items to the 14:30–14:45 slice if Raj needs to drop in briefly? Alternatively, if Finlytics prefers a re-slot, we can hold 13:00–13:45 or 14:30–15:15 — please confirm which feels least disruptive.

Proposed brief agenda (will publish a calendar invite + agenda doc once time is confirmed):
- 0–5m: Introductions & outcome framing (SoojIN / Helen)
- 5–25m: Technical walkthrough (Marissa) — model serving, SSO flow, network requirements
- 25–40m: Procurement + security Q&A (Sean + Marissa) — license terms, evidence owners, SOC2 specifics
- 40–45m: Next steps & action items (SoojIN)

Marissa — can you attach the SOC2 summary and a simple network diagram (redwood_svc boundary) for Maria to scan ahead of the call? Helen — if you can confirm SSO vendor (Okta / Azure AD / other) that helps us scope the demo.

Thanks — I’ll hold the tentative slot on our side and publish the invite once you confirm the preferred time.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0144
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cope@redwood.com>
To: Helen Cho <helen.cho@finlytics.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finlytics.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finlytics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning next steps and stakeholders for a focused technical deep dive

Helen / Raj / Maria — thanks for folding me in. Confirming that Thu 7 Oct 14:00 PT works for our team; we’ll aim to keep procurement points to the final 15 minutes so Raj can cover what he needs.

Per Soojin’s ask, attaching: SOC2_summary.pdf (redwood controlled), network_arch_diagram.png (high-level). I’ve also dropped a very short agenda doc to the Drive link Soojin referenced — it contains specific checkpoints we’ll demo (SSO: OIDC flow, example request/response times, caching/kv behavior).

Helen — quick Q on the SSO vendor (you mentioned Okta in the call notes — is that correct?). If you can confirm, Marissa will include a short SSO checklist in the invite.

Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cope@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0177
